notes.title: MEC Release (v1.0) + Giveaway to win a 3D MousePad
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42885383/6983cd500f830688682c40fe1edb69e62f0c52d0.jpg

Here we are!
My Escort Company is now available in version 1.0! It wouldn't be possible without the amazing support from the (18+) community and our Patrons! You have been many to send us feedback since the version 0.1 six months ago on the Steam community but also on Discord! 

Donator DLC
Some of you even joined the Lewd Tribe on Patreon to shape the game and see all the behind the scene, unreleased elements & pictures we made for the game but decided to not include.
They also voted for the girls that would be released during the EA.
They made us switch the gameplay from "turn based" to "real time" which is way more fun and active than the previous one.
During the making we also made a vote in our community about the DONATOR DLC, which was providing, in our other games, exclusive content and features for Patrons. They voted "no" about it so we don't made one for the game and everything is available to everyone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42885383/dca77b33944896784ebb3c63f6cb20c266cf98de.png
3D MousePad giveaway
To reward this "high level" community we are organizing a merchandising giveaway on Patreon for them with a 3D mouse pad featuring the escorts girls of MEC! There are two to win, one on Jul3D community and another one on NSFW18 Games community.

Update 1.0
The content was almost fully unlocked since last release but now Kimmy is also available!

What's New (v1.0): 
- New content - ALL Kimmy's content is now available in the Gallery and you can unlock it like every other girl! Remember that Kimmy is the real 18+ model KimmySun and you can discover all her content here: https://twitter.com/kkimkkimmy 

- Improvement - Since Kimmy is your councelor, she can't be used as an escort girl but she is part of your company so she will now appear from the start in the company view but also in the intro group picture like any other unlocked girl!

- Improvement - Gifts! I improved the system and you have now new warnings if there is no content unlockable at the moment!

- Bugs : I fixed a lot of issues/weird behaviors in the Gift panel when you were trying to open a lot of gift at the same time (10+) or if there was not enough content to unlock with all stars you may have. it was causing bugs and making sometimes the stars to disapear.
Example: you have 50 stars but there are only 2 content available with your current girls, it was using your 50 stars (10 gifts) to unlock the 2 and nothing else. Now you will have a limite of 2 gifts even if you have more because there is no other content to unlock.

- Bugs: Video audio was not looping and wasn't controled by the Voice Volume. Fixed.

- Bug: XP text ("25/30") was disapearing after reaching level 7. Fixed.

- Bug: Some texts were black on dark color. Fixed.

- Bug: Blowjob video audio wasn't synch after first loop (silence in the track). Fixed.

- Bug: Black overlap in the welcome screen with Kimmy. Fixed.

- Bug: "Next" & "Previous" buttons in the Gallery were displayed weirdly. Fixed.

Not Related, the Steam page is now available in 6 languages.

notes.title: Update 0.92 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42885383/00a252d6be8dba072fae7db686ccf4d53812f8df.jpg
Hello Lewd Tribe!

Another hotfix to correct all the bugs found by the player and optimize some elements.

What's new in this update?
- Task manager #1: thanks to your feedback I found that the main issues of "unupdated elements" in the Task Manager was because of I refresh the panel everytime you buy an upgrade or girl and some elements were not correctly updated. This update is necessary so I added an extra step, a pause, when you purchase an update/girl with a popup that explain that everything has been reset (and correctly reset now).

- Kinks in Gallery: There was a problem with the save of the kinks in the Gallery. It's now fixed. They will be unlocked and saved correctly. Sorry about those you unlocked some...
- Kinks videos: All 100 kink videos have now been transcoded and should be more fluid (the computer processed all the videos the last night^^).
- Warning: Some warnings weren't displaying the correct text ("empty"). Fixed.
- Upgrade #2 wrong cost: The upgrade #2 price displayed was $1000 instead of the real price $1500. Fixed.
- Company upgrade: Added a max level to all Company upgrades ^^
- Day timer: The day timer was really bugged when you pause time. It's now fixed and working perfectly :)
- Level up: I reworked the level up system which was not designed correctly and limited to level 3. It's now working way more smoothly and auto-updated (xp max is now 999).
- Training: The money necessary to train a girl was added instead of removed from your total money, it's fixed. The party is over ;)

Thank you for all of you who took the time to report the issues you found on Discord or Steam Discussion! 

It's super heavy important for me! You rock!

notes.title: Update 0.91 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Thank you for participating in the Early Access, I received some feedback about bugs in the game so here is a little hotfix.
Some players also complained about lag in Kink Videos (blowjob, hardcore, public sex...) and I'm transcoding all videos with a new more mainstream codec but it takes a lot of time since there are 110 videos to transcode. I will replace the old ones by the new ones as soon as it is done.

Patchnote v0.91:

- Unclickable girls in Rewards : solved

- Energy not displayed correctly on the girl icon in Task Manager or in the info panel at the bottom : solved 
It now refresh every day, every time you rollover a girl and every time the panel is close/open.
I also changed the behavior when a girl is out of energy when doing task. Previously the girl was still on work even with 0 energy and removed (with a warning) if she continues working another day. Now she will be removed (with a warning) as soon as she reach 0 energy.

- New hired girls not displayed on the left panel of the Task Manager : solved

- Weird behavior in Gift panel : solved
When you click a gift the 2 other disappear and the selected gift is displayed in the middle. I also made the animation faster (1sec >> 0.75s) and removed some empty frame at the beginning so the transition is played faster. It should avoid the "it's not working" feeling.

--

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1759920/discussions/0/3719440592187742258/

notes.title: Update 0.90 - Giga update (all girls, all content, new gameplay...)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42885383/ce8a3fcb734875b838932a035bb4ca04adf95f7b.jpg
Hello Players!

Today is the day, the final update for My Escort Company is now available!

This project started in April 2022 for Jul3D and I. It was a long term project with a lot of different stages, from prototyping the gameplay, designing the girls to finally arrive to this new version which is very different from the first one.
During the early access more than 1200 players tried the game, 3600 hours played, more than 40.000 events sent to my Unity Event Tracking system and a LOT of feedback on the different channels!

I will post again tomorrow with an extended description of each available girl.

What's new in this update?
- Reworked "day to day" gameplay from a "turn-based" to "real time" making everything smoother and without pause time (pause is still possible with a button).

- The Request/Rest/Training tabs have been merged in one single screen called Task Manager where you can assign and monitor your girls! It's probably the most trickiest part of the game!

- From 1 Girl in September to 5 girls in March and now 10! You now have access to all girls! Available for hire and the naughty content in the Gallery.

- From 1 Location (the office) to 2 (downtown) in v0.2, you now have access to 6 areas and 17 locations. Areas unlock locations and girls while locations open new spot for request/training or resting! Each location has different costs and benefits. Some will give you a lot of money in exchange of a lot of energy and others will be totally free for a small energy bonus.

- The Gallery has been extended with 3 filters: Place - Kinks - Posing (change pose and outfits of the girls in your office).
Each girl now has:

- 18 Places (striptease with 3 steps each)

- 10 Kinks video (sex scenes)

- 10 poses + 4 outfits

42 elements (40 to unlock - 2 available when you recruit them) which mean 420 item in total (400 to unlock).

- To unlock those elements, the "star system" is now available! You will collect one star every time one of the girl is answering a request in a her favorite location. You will receive 10 stars at the end of the tutorial to test that. The first 3 girls available (Aki, Kimmy, Hanaye) have the same favorite place which is The Gaming Room available at the beginning of the game so the first choice will not impact your performance (like in the previous version) and you can pick only the one you prefer!

- Girls can now level up to infinite level with the training.

- Girls now all appear in the office with the outfit or pose you select in the Gallery.

- We also created new upgrades like the possibility to increase your profit per request or reducing the time between each new day making the gameplay easier but way more nervous at the end.

City Upgrades and Company upgrades are now separated for more clarity and avoid confusion. It's still possible to access one from the other using the arrows.

Each upgrade also has cool backgrounds :)

- We doubled the number of logos available when you create your company and the possibility to edit the company name/logo and colors when you want from the panel options. We really want to thank you all the members of the community who sent ideas for the company logos especially DickDuck on Steam for the "kiss design he made for the game.

- Reworked Tutoriel with new steps and Help Panel (available when you finish tuto).
You can now skip the tutoriel if needed.

- The profil of each girl now include new information (number of request answered, level, XP,...).

What's Next?
We will wait for your feedback to improve the game and correct the bugs which could have been forgot. In the meantime, we will rework the Steam page for the release, update all the visual. We will also add achievements directly in the game as well as extra translations which were incomplete for this release - including Portuguese for which we received a lot of help from the community.

Speaking of translation, if you want to help us, don't hesitate to join the Discord and participate. Any help is greatly appreciated!
